title: Three Queens Fire, Washington: 9,575 Acres, 75% Contained #shorts
description:
The Three Queens Fire in Kittitas County, Washington has burned 9,575 acres and is 75% contained, according to the National Interagency Fire Center. It started on Jul 15 (95 days ago).

33 personnel are assigned to it.

Fire sizes and containment are the latest reported to NIFC and can lag what's happening on the ground.

Get severe weather alerts for your location, free: https://www.stormcentralwx.com

Storm Central is not an official warning system. Follow evacuation orders from local officials and the incident's official updates.
